limitations: The Float32-staged mean of independently verified application geometryNormals matches every native STL encoded normal. The vertex cache itself is not directly compared with an unobserved native QSF normal cache. Application geometric facetNormals remain a distinct preserved carrier.

publicStlExporterScope.scope: The generic public STL serializer is outside the compared Re-polygonize operation representation. No whole-STL-file byte identity is claimed.
publicStlExporterScope.existingBehavior: src/io.ts exportStl passes positions to Three STLExporter, which writes normalized geometric facet-cross normals and zero uint16 attribute words. It does not serialize the native unnormalized mean-normal encoding or native 0x2020 words.
publicStlExporterScope.operationComparison: The actual GUI/MCP output indexed vertex-normal cache is independently checked; its Float32-staged triangle-corner mean reproduces every retained native STL normal record. This validates the observable normal information without claiming direct equality between different normal carriers or generic exporter formats.

unknownNativeOwnerFields: Raw native QSF computed-vertex/facet-normal cache bytes were not observed or inferred from the export.
All retained native STL attribute words are 0x2020. They remain opaque export metadata; no semantic native owner attribute equivalence is asserted.
rawArchiveWordingClarification: The immutable exactArchiveSummary retains its original shorthand sentence saying geometryNormals match the native STL encoded mean. The actual executed comparison and the formula above compare the MEAN OF the three vertex normals with each STL normal record, not the differently shaped carriers directly. Raw archive/receipt pins and captured values remain unchanged.
